title: "Budget and Revenue"
jupyter: python3

```{python}
#| echo: true
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

This page compares film production budgets with worldwide revenues. In @fig-budget-revenue, each point represents one film, with both amounts measured in millions of US dollars.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| fig-cap: "Production budget and worldwide revenue, in millions of US dollars"
#| label: fig-budget-revenue

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Production budget (millions of US dollars)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
